reviewContext.userProblem: vactr editor carries a private vim engine (editor/src/code/vim/**) that duplicates emaki/vim (emaki 9dba0a3 in editor/node_modules/emaki); vactr should consume the engine, keymap schema/presets/compile, KeymapStore and controller from emaki with no user-visible behavior loss.
requiredOutcomes: editor/src/code/vim and editor/test/code/vim deleted; no vactr source imports a local vim engine module; vim features come from emaki/vim.
vim-mount.ts builds the controller with createVimController and exports createVimHost, createVimOptions and forwardSurfaceUpdates with pinned signatures (VM-D1 to VM-D7, VM-D9).
TauriKeymapStore implements emaki KeymapStore; browser persistence uses emaki LocalKeymapStore with key vactr.vimKeymap; migrateLegacyActionIds migrates the seven legacy action IDs (VM-D3, VM-D7).
Solid status/hints/keymap views, clipboard and decorations typed against emaki/vim snapshots (VM-D8).
Mounted parity oracle editor/test/canvas/vim-parity.test.ts (P1a x2, P1b, P2a, P2b, P3 x5, P4) written at base and never edited later.

Gates in editor/: npm run check, npx vitest run, npm run build, npm run test:style, npm run e2e:examples, node test/e2e/vim-behavior.mjs, node test/e2e/vim-keymap.mjs; each logged with exit value; failures classified as VMB1-VMB4, BASE-FAIL, NEW-REGRESSION or environment-blocked.
Behavior parity mapping table from each removed vactr vim module/test to its emaki counterpart or retained vactr integration test; blocker report naming the exact missing emaki APIs.
nonGoals: Re-implementing engine logic in vactr to cover missing emaki APIs.
Running npm install / npm ci or changing the emaki pin in editor/package.json or package-lock.json.
Any Rust, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock change.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths; sharedPaths only per sharedPathNotes; no worktrees, no worker commits, no push.
Evidence logs go under the repository-root tmp/emaki-vim/<planId>/ (from editor/ use ../tmp/emaki-vim/<planId>/); per-attempt subdirectories allowed.
Heavy runs take the measure lock /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr-worktrees/.measure-lock (rules item 12).
No assertion may be weakened, skipped or deleted; session.test.ts expect lines stay byte-identical.

Design section 10 and EQ7 default (a): if VMB1/VMB2/VMB4 remain confirmed-failing, the implementation stays uncommitted and the run reports blocked; this overrides the workflowInput commit instruction.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: VM-D1 to VM-D7, VM-D9: rewire vim-mount onto createVimController with a vactr action registry, ex handler for {w,q,wq,x}, render switches off, keymap compile through migrateLegacyActionIds, noteUpdate then blur on a file boundary.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps vactr glue (eval/format/diagnostics/completion actions, file-boundary handling, Solid views) in vactr while the engine comes from emaki/vim.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: VM-D8: views consume emaki VimSnapshot (prompt.text, hints, hop null when off).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: emaki snapshot replaces local engine state types without changing rendered output.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: VM-D10: session.test.ts rebuilt with createVimHost stubs and byte-identical assertions.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps the file-boundary redo regression test as a vactr integration test after engine removal.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Parity oracle EVM-10 written first at base a998d1e and read-only afterwards.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Gives a mounted, engine-independent oracle that detects behavior loss after the rewire.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: EVM-40 gate 11 (HEAD must equal a998d1e) is checked as: no committed editor/ change between a998d1e and HEAD.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The plan checkpoint commit (docs, plans, manifest only) moves HEAD past a998d1e; the gate's intent is that workers commit no implementation.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: EQ7 default (a): no scope amendment; VMB1, VMB2, VMB4 block completion, VMB3 only if P4 fails.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: emaki 9dba0a3 lacks resetDocument/isDocumentBoundary, an ex message return value and a normalizeKey export; emaki is read-only in this run.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-11 round 1: authorize generated build and gate outputs as artifactRoots [tmp/emaki-vim/cargo-target, editor/dist, tmp/ui-style/after, tmp/examples-e2e] for EVM-10 and EVM-40; the wasm release build uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=tmp/emaki-vim/cargo-target and the editor build uses VACTR_WASM from it, so the shared target/ is not written; rules item 14 is superseded.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plan EVM-10: base gates 3 to 8 and their rebuild prerequisites were unrun because the generated output paths were not authorized. EVM-40 gets the same contract in advance. The two plans are in waves 1 and 4, so the shared roots never clash. The prior EVM-10 evidence (oracle 11/11, check exit 0) is kept.

intentionalTradeoffs: The expected end state is blocked; partial migration remains uncommitted rather than shipping a parity loss.
P4 may be re-baselined to observed base behavior as documented in EVM-10.
Wave 2 plans use filtered tsc and targeted vitest only; full gates run in single-plan waves to avoid cross-worker noise.
supportedEdgeCases: Legacy persisted keymaps with the seven old action IDs migrate on load.
Document boundary (file load) resets insert/visual mode, dot-repeat and undo ledger (P1, depends on VMB1).
:w, :q, :wq, :x show the live-sync status message (P3, depends on VMB2).
User-authored cmdline remaps work in the status prompt (P2, depends on VMB4).
Meta-key platform shortcuts pass through (P4, VMB3 conditional).
Missing browser runtime for e2e/style gates is recorded as environment-blocked.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Bumping the emaki pin or reinstalling node_modules.
New vim features beyond current vactr behavior.
